scope: Public map context for Fresno County. No private asset records or Waze credentials are bundled.

waterways.sourceCRS: EPSG:3857; service also exposes Z/M, not used for water elevations
waterways.displayFilterCRS: EPSG:4326 Fresno County polygon in site/data/counties.geojson
waterways.filter: LayerView intersects; source segments are retained, not clipped. Complete segments can cross the border.
waterways.label: gnisidlabel
waterways.date: featuredate is source feature metadata, not observation time
waterways.length: lengthkm describes the full source segment, in kilometers

countyNameCheck.method: Server query with exact county polygon; distinct gnisidlabel and featuretypelabel, blank names excluded. Names are not counts of independent waterways.

limitations: Combines new 3DHP data with legacy NHD coverage
Local district aliases and operations are unverified
Connectors can describe network continuity rather than a physical channel
No flood, water-level or current-flow inference

buildings.publisher: Esri Living Atlas, derived from Overture Maps
buildings.display: Lazy 3D-only SceneLayer, scale 1:80000 or closer, approximate gray reference forms
buildings.countyMatches: Not implemented. Requires private reviewed county-ID to Overture parent-building GERS crosswalk from a versioned source extract.
limitations: No surveyed floor elevations, flood protection, power readiness or safe-access inference
ObjectID is not a durable county relationship key
Overture building-part IDs are outside the parent-building GERS stability commitment

waze.connection: Pending; no feed URL, token or partner records in this release
requirements: Managed server process and secret store
Private AGOL output with appropriate county access
Validate current agreement, timestamps, units, stable IDs and 5000-event completeness limit
waze.interim: Esri Waze for Cities Live Alerts Data Pipeline ff20f111a8044d209dc74efaa9ddd9c2; private owner-only configuration, 15-minute minimum schedule, input caching disabled; privileges and credit budget required.
